thread:
ravi: quick FYI - onboarding sample app (node) broken on embeddings step. REST accepts `namespace` query param to scope vectors but `sdk.embeddings.create({model: 'embed-1', input: 'x', namespace: 'team-a'})` gets ignored and we get unexpected collisions. anyone aware?

jen: oof. which sdk version + sample app commit? we landed a change to the param mapping recently to normalize camelCase.

ravi: sdk@0.9.8, sample app commit 4f2a2b. repro: curl -> `GET /v1/embeddings?namespace=team-a` returns 200 and namespaced index. node sdk call returns 200 but `namespace` absent in network trace.

kyle: sounds like the Node SDK is dropping unknown props before serializing. We did that intentionally to keep signatures small but we added a whitelist that missed `namespace` (service-level qs).

jen: this is bad for onboarding because the quickstart sandbox uses `team-a` in examples and collisions confuse new users. we had two signups who reported duplicates in the vector store earlier today.

ravi: workaround is to pass raw headers: `sdk.request('GET', '/v1/embeddings', { qs: { namespace: 'team-a' }})` but that's ugly for new devs.

kyle: I'll put together a patch to reintroduce passthrough for service-level query params and add a test comparing SDK serialization vs raw curl coverage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/278 (WIP).

qa-bot: test alert: failing integration test embeddings_namespace_spec.js in CI for branch release/0.9.x - namespace not applied.

jen: can we get a patch release? sample app pins 0.9.x in quickstart. If we wait till next major, onboarding churn will keep increasing.

release-eng: we can cut a 0.9.9 with the fix. need changelog entry and approval from security for the metadata passthrough change (we review for PII risk).

kyle: security note - passthrough will only allow a short opt-in list of service params (namespace, region), not arbitrary headers. adding test coverage and an allowlist should satisfy the review.

ravi: thanks. i'll update the sample app docs to include temporary workaround and mark the quickstart issue as high priority. also tagging the two customers who reported this so support can follow up.

jen: also tighten retry semantics while you're in that area: the SDK currently retries on 401 during token refresh which results in duplicate upserts to the vector index. please don't retry mutating calls on auth failures.

kyle: noted - will update retry policy: no automatic retry for mutating endpoints on 401/403. add a telemetry event when a retry was suppressed so we can correlate with customer reports.

release-eng: once PR lands, I'll run a candidate build and patch release. ping me when CI green.

ravi: appreciate it. this was a nasty onboarding surprise for a few trial users today - want to get the hotfix out ASAP.
